detail.longDescription: Hi everyone, Here is a situation: In a typical company these days, many employees are creating tools using AI (Claude & Cursor) to help with their work. They run these tools on their own computers, which no one else can use or on a builder platform with a public URL and either no login or a hand-rolled one the agent wrote. Question: Where do they run this? Who can see it? What happens if an employee leaves the company?
